# Generated by pyke from whiteboard.pyke - do not edit, changes will be overwritten.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(Inkwell VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

include(FetchContent)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_EXAMPLES "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_SHARED "ON" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(sdl3_src
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git
    GIT_TAG release-3.4.16
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_Declare(vulkan_headers
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers.git
    GIT_TAG vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
set(VOLK_INSTALL "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(VULKAN_HEADERS_INSTALL_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/vulkan_headers-src" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(volk
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/zeux/volk.git
    GIT_TAG vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
set(VMA_BUILD_SAMPLES "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(VMA_BUILD_DOCUMENTATION "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(vma
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator.git
    GIT_TAG v3.4.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
set(GLM_BUILD_TESTS "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLM_BUILD_LIBRARY "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_20 "ON" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(glm_src
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/g-truc/glm.git
    GIT_TAG 1.0.3
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_INSTALL "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(spdlog
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/gabime/spdlog.git
    GIT_TAG v1.17.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
set(INSTALL_GTEST "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_GMOCK "OFF" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(gtest_force_shared_crt "ON" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(GTest
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/google/googletest.git
    GIT_TAG v1.18.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(sdl3_src)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(vulkan_headers)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(volk)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(vma)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glm_src)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(spdlog)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(GTest)

enable_testing()

add_subdirectory(libs/SDL3)
add_subdirectory(libs/Vulkan)
add_subdirectory(libs/glm)
add_subdirectory(libs/stb)
add_subdirectory(libs/ImGui)
add_subdirectory(core)
add_subdirectory(app)
add_subdirectory(tests)
